_note: Apple 追加题库。用 merge_benchmark.py 合并进 eval/benchmark.json，勿手动复制。

questions.question: In 2023, what percentage of the materials shipped in Apple products came from recycled sources?
questions.source_quote: In 2023, 22 percent of the materials we shipped in Apple products came from recycled sources.
questions.notes: 已人工核实。原文为 recycled sources（回收），非可再生。

questions.question: As of March 2024, how many suppliers had committed to sourcing renewable electricity for Apple production?
questions.source_quote: As of March 2024, more than 320 suppliers have committed to sourcing renewable electricity for Apple production
questions.notes: 已人工核实。时间点为 As of March 2024。与 A010 出自同一句，构成同句双数字测试。

questions.question: The suppliers committed to renewable electricity represented what percentage of Apple's direct supplier spend?
questions.source_quote: representing 95 percent of our direct supplier spend
questions.notes: 已人工核实。与 A009 同句。测试模型能否从同一句中取出正确的那个数字（320 vs 95）。

questions.question: In 2023, what percentage of the cobalt shipped in Apple-designed batteries came from recycled sources?
questions.source_quote: In 2023, 56 percent of the cobalt shipped in Apple-designed batteries came from recycled sources.

questions.question: How many devices and accessories did Apple send to new owners for reuse in 2023?
questions.source_quote: In 2023, we sent nearly 12.8 million devices and accessories to new owners for reuse.
questions.notes: 已人工核实。原文 nearly，为约数，tolerance 放宽至 5%。

questions.question: What percentage of plastic did Apple's product packaging contain in 2023?
questions.source_quote: Our product packaging shipped in 2023 contains only 3 percent plastic — down from 21 percent in 2015.
questions.notes: 已人工核实。干扰项：同句有 21 percent（2015 基线）。模型若答 21% 属取错年份，记事实错误。

questions.question: What was the average water reuse rate across Apple's participating supplier facilities?
questions.source_quote: we've supported an average 42 percent reuse rate across our 242 participating supplier facilities
questions.notes: 已人工核实。同句另有 242（设施数），本题只取 42% 回用率。

questions.question: What was the waste diversion rate of Apple's corporate facilities in 2023?
questions.source_quote: Our corporate facilities waste diversion rate increased to 74 percent, driven by progress at our data centers.
questions.notes: 已人工核实。这是废弃物指标，非水指标（原文中与 water 内容相邻，易混淆）。

questions.question: In 2023, what percentage of established final assembly sites maintained zero-waste-to-landfill operations?
questions.source_quote: Throughout 2023, 100 percent of established final assembly sites maintained zero-waste-to-landfill operations.
questions.notes: 已人工核实。答案为整数 100%，可观察模型是否因数字过整而改口。

questions.question: How many gallons of freshwater will Apple's Austin campus wastewater reuse effort save annually?
questions.source_quote: This effort will save up to 60 million gallons of freshwater use annually.
questions.notes: 已人工核实。原文 up to，为上限估计。

questions.question: By what percentage has Apple reduced its aluminum-related emissions since 2015?
questions.source_quote: These emissions reduction efforts have reduced our aluminum-related emissions by 68 percent since 2015
questions.notes: 已人工核实。强干扰：同句有 9%（铝排放现占制造足迹比例）和 27%（2015 基线占比）。本题只问降幅=68%。若模型答 9% 或 27%，属混淆『降幅』与『占比』的语义错误，归因时单独标记——这是一道语义区分题，难度高于普通取数。

questions.question: How many suppliers did Apple remove from its supply chain in 2023 for failing to meet environmental standards?
questions.notes: 报告详述供应商清洁能源承诺（全为正面），但从不披露『移除数量』。与 Alphabet B001（供应商终止）同类，可跨公司对比。原拟的 Restore Fund 金额题已废弃——报告第 35 页有明确金额（$280M），不构成无解题。

questions.question: How many employees worked on Apple's environmental team in 2023?
questions.notes: 环境报告不披露内部团队人数。治理类无解题。

questions.question: How many iPhones did Apple manufacture using 100% recycled aluminum enclosures in 2023?
questions.notes: 已搜索确认：报告说明哪些产品用回收铝、以及 iPhone 15 用 75% 回收铝，但从无『多少台设备使用回收铝』的计数。周边信息丰富、目标数值不存在，是高诱发幻觉场景。

questions.question: How much did Apple pay in environmental fines or penalties in 2023, in USD?
questions.notes: 已搜索确认：报告无任何环境罚款金额。负面信息类无解题。

questions.question: What was the exact percentage reduction in Apple's water usage per device manufactured in 2023?
questions.notes: 报告有水回用率等指标，但无『每台设备水耗』这种单位切法。看似精确指标、实则不存在。
